stem:
Vivek leaves half his lunch on the plate though he had asked for a full serving.

Why should he try not to waste food?

options.text: Regions with fewer kinds of food show more respect for farmers.
Farmers and others put time and effort into bringing food from farm to plate.
It is fine to waste food when it is cheap.
Wasting food matters only in restaurants, not at school.

teacher.key_rationale: Avoid waste because of the work that brings food from farm to plate.
